notes: d1-omni-600M decision graph, L128 bucket (the shipped file d1-omni-600M_decide_L128_fp16.tflite, 896250176 B; see the galaxy-s26 record of 2026-10-08 for the model and the file), on a Pixel 8a (Tensor G3, Mali-G715, 8 GB) through the same gate app as the Galaxy S26 records. CPU (XNNPACK 4 threads): the 101 test rows pass the pass bar. GPU (OpenCL, Mali): the delegate accepted every node, but the compile of this 896 MB graph does not fit the phone's memory at harness guards of 1.5 GB and 1.0 GB (the second attempt had lowmemorykiller killing background apps while the app stayed alive) = no GPU result on this phone; the same file compiles and runs on the 12 GB Galaxy S26 (its record). The same passes also ran the vision tower, the projector and the audio T1001 graphs on this phone (GPU and CPU, finite outputs, same order as the Galaxy S26 runs) without a scored parity check = no records for them here. A Pixel result does not stand in for a Galaxy S26 result: GPU op support and fp16 behaviour differ between Mali and Adreno.
